badger-pass.note: In Yosemite National Park; lifts = 1 triple, 3 doubles, 1 handle tow. Ticket page lists prices and links to the operator's booking widget.

china-peak.note: Six chairlifts (2 quads, 4 triples) plus 3 moving carpets; the site gives the summit only as 'just over 8,700 feet'.

mt-shasta-ski-park.note: No summit figure published. The hours page still carries an off-season banner; its weekend closing times conflict (Fri to 7 PM / Sat to 6 PM vs 4 PM).

heavenly.hours_note: Only opening-day hours are posted so far (9:00 AM - 4:00 PM, California side); regular-season hours not yet published.

timberline.hours_note: Read from the ticket windows: full-day tickets 9 AM - close, Summit Pass 9 AM - 4 PM, night session 4-8 PM. Night skiing on Bruno's and Pucci, Friday and Saturday nights from Christmas, plus holiday periods, into March. Summer skiing on Palmer.
